method: each guide sub-task read verbatim, matched to a delivered artifact AND a runnable test; a second pass re-read the spec line by line

requirements.text: keep fractional volume, UTC units and symbol mapping exact

requirements.text: bar close must be trustworthy
requirements.evidence: MEASURED DEFECT: close_time is correct for BTC/ETH/DOGE perps, lands near the 1970 epoch for SOL and BNB, is mixed for BTC spot, and is even stored as a STRING in some spot partitions. The lab derives bar_close = time + interval and treats close_time as a diagnostic

requirements.text: 1m -> 15m/1h/4h resampling
requirements.note: only 4h was verified on the first pass
requirements.evidence: all three targets produced and their aggregation contract checked on a real partition: OHLC first/max/min/last, flows summed, level columns take the LAST value

requirements.text: sample_time for snapshots
requirements.evidence: the book product's availability comes from its real sample_time; measured spread 0 to 3593s inside the hour

requirements.text: funding events kept separate
requirements.evidence: no funding product exists anywhere in this storage; recorded MISSING with the rule that it is never treated as zero carry

requirements.text: missing / stale status and TTL
reads fail closed, never warning-only
requirements.evidence: assess() raises DataQualityError on a primary read; 385 partitions checked, 0 failures

requirements.text: G1-G5 per section 6
requirements.evidence: realized vol, direction descriptor, path efficiency, downside ratio, jump concentration; taker imbalance, log activity, trade count; dlog OI, basis, return x OI; spread and a log impact proxy; dispersion, breadth, factor concentration, beta residual

requirements.text: fixed core schema inside the complexity budget
requirements.evidence: the primary core is exactly 8 features and contains only features covering all five symbols; G3 (BTC/ETH) and G4 (BTC, weeks) are cohort EXTENSIONS rather than silently-NaN core columns

requirements.text: training-only scaler and group weights
requirements.evidence: median/MAD fitted on the development role 2020-01-01..2023-12-31 only; w_j = omega_g/d_g

requirements.text: distinguish market from local signals
requirements.evidence: every FeatureSpec carries a scope; G5 market features are built from the point-in-time eligible universe

requirements.text: retain intermediate raw aggregates
zero dispersion must be missing, not strong evidence
requirements.evidence: ratio features mask a zero denominator instead of adding an epsilon

requirements.text: inventory the external sources with their correct meaning and usage rules
requirements.evidence: DefiLlama, Whale Alert, Farside ETF and Coin Metrics inventoried with the guide's caveats

requirements.text: acquisition is a separate write-to-lab stage
requirements.evidence: nothing acquired; no socket is opened; network is off in run stages

requirements.text: the primary must run without enrichment
requirements.evidence: the primary core is server-core only and FREE_ENRICHED is empty

requirements.text: listing, warmup and usable intervals per symbol
market-universe membership point-in-time
sources
revisions and masks
requirements.evidence: two repairs are documented beside the loader, and one is VISIBLE in the data: the 2026-05 partitions for BTC and ETH carry a second ingest day (2026-06-12) covering ~44k rows, which is the documented continuity repair. The window is masked in every panel as in_documented_repair_window

requirements.text: cohorts reported separately, never intersected
batch and streamed features must be prefix-equal
market-context universe may be wider than the five traded symbols
requirements.evidence: measured: this storage holds exactly FIVE perpetual symbols; the other 48 symbol directories are dated quarterly contracts of the same underlyings, which are expiries rather than additional assets. The universe therefore cannot be widened here, so G5 breadth/dispersion over five symbols is a constraint of the data, not a design shortcut

requirements.text: a bounded historical slice per alpha-symbol
requirements.evidence: 20 cells, 1500 bars each from 2022-03-01, all in the development role

requirements.text: check gaps, HTF, warmup and the account trace
requirements.evidence: 20/20 cells qualified: no intent during warmup, a finite account trace of the right length, engine fills produced

requirements.text: domain smoke only, not model selection
keep the slice in the development role
requirements.evidence: every record carries data_role=development

exit_gate.server_core_cohort: 5 symbols, 2020-09-14 common period, explicit coverage and publication assumptions
exit_gate.future_mutation_tests: pass through the loader, the resampler and the scaler

second_audit_gaps_closed: L03.1 read the real product docs (they explain every absence)
L03.2 spot clean-from-2020 convention applied to eligibility
L03.3 all three resample targets produced and their contract checked
L03.6 revisions and the repair mask
read-lock: rolling-window products are mutable by design and must not be judged as corruption
L03.6 market-universe width checked (it cannot be widened on this storage)

recorded_limitations.detail: no funding product exists in this storage; every primary run is a labelled no-funding cohort and may not claim realistic net carry
spot exists for BTCUSDT only by collector configuration, so basis is a BTC-only feature
the metrics collector never listed SOL/BNB/DOGE, so G3 can only ever cover BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT here
the order-book product keeps a rolling 30-day window, so SERVER_LIQUIDITY can never support a historical study and g4_spread_bps has no development-window data to scale on
the stored close_time column is defective for SOL/BNB perps and BTC spot; bar close is derived and close_time is never used for availability
SOLUSDT's quantity step changed mid-sample, so a single pinned instrument step would be wrong for part of the history
tick and lot metadata are INFERRED from observed granularity, not read from venue metadata
only five perpetual symbols exist in this storage, so G5 breadth, dispersion and factor concentration are computed over five assets; a wider market-context universe is not available
